He conducted coaching seminars in Virginia and Florida and maintained active mentoring relationships with notable figures such as his student Gene LeBell and associations with Gokor Chivichyan and LeBell's Hayastan MMA Academy [d668815s10p0]. sub_answers.text: He developed a strong amateur wrestling foundation, training in Greco-Roman and later folkstyle and freestyle wrestling from childhood under his father and later John Zastro, which prepared him for professional work [d668815s2p0]. Tom Packs, a professional promoter, recruited him and sent him to George Tragos for further coaching, establishing an apprenticeship/mentorship pathway into pro wrestling [d668815s2p0]. In later life he served as a special guest referee, promoter, commissioner and occasional trainer for UWFi, and he held regular seminars (including spending one week every month in Japan teaching catch-wrestling techniques), demonstrating formal teaching and industry roles that qualified him to train and produce others [d668815s10p0].
